line_crossing_summary.limitations_note: Virtual line counting accuracy may be affected by drone camera ego-motion, perspective foreshortening, occlusions, and track ID switches.

camera_operator_suggestions.recommendation: Consider adjusting sensor angle towards South-East (Bottom-Right) and applying optical zoom to inspect crowd formation and potential bottlenecks.
camera_operator_suggestions.rationale: 62.5% of all detected individuals are concentrated in South-East (Bottom-Right), indicating a local density peak.
